$Comment: Frost beam 'Ice... KING!' (2026-10-21: a powerful attack that does a lot of damage, like the Souls-like bosses; concept: charges a ray of frost, beam of ice energy in front of him, stops in his tracks and is vulnerable, multi-hit, a freeze stack each hit, launch on the last). 1.6 s charge standing still with a strong hand glow and the ground warning sound, then 5 bolts 0.22 s apart, each drawing an ice beam from his right hand (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Beam x4, _Final with the push), then 1 s still. 52 damage and 5 frost stacks if all hit. Animation: own IDs FrostBeamCharging / FrostBeamFire (2026-10-21). Ground phase 1 only (CAE_AT_Ice_King FrostBeam): a movement lock on a flier is untested. 2026-10-21 : each bolt is a hand throw, alternating right/left (FrostBeamFire / FrostBeamFireL, 0.25 s each at Speed 2): R, L, R, L, R, and each bolt leaves from the throwing hand (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Beam = right, _L = left, _Final = right). Bolts 0.25 s apart (was 0.22) to match one throw each; the shoot sound is the projectile's own LaunchWorldSoundEventId. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the burst = quick shots one after another alternating L R L R L R; the two-hand burst is a separate attack): 6 throws L, R, L, R, L, R (FrostBeamFireL / FrostBeamFire), one bolt from the throwing hand each, the last (right) with the push (_Final); the charge is FrostBeamChargingL (left arm back), matching the first throw. 5 x 8 + 20 = 60 Ice, 6 frost stacks if all hit.

Interactions.$Comment: Recovery: stays still 1 s after the beam, the window to punish him.
